result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other per-rep counts.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6517). The subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter and latest purchase-order queries use.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java` gets a new `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test. It mirrors your example: Anna gets 2 and Bob gets 1. I added a `purchaseOrder(warehouse, date, status)` overload to the test's helper so the test can create cancelled orders.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures). I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
